arms.AC3 preview did not move: HELD across 7 canvas switches, both themes, with the known-firing Go to door firing in each run

idempotence: two consecutive runs compared field by field: identical. The script now RESETS the preview to the start page first and refuses if the reset did not take — see findings.

findings.what: the outline pointed at the node that PLACES the component, and drew nothing
findings.measured: placement id -> found 1, getRef present, getDOMElement ABSENT. painting id -> found 1, getDOMElement -> DIV 973x72.
findings.whyItHid: getRef is only the highlighter's existence filter; the element comes from getDOMElement in updateHighlights. The instance passes the filter, so selectedNodes.size reads a healthy 1 and NOTHING is on screen. A count-based arm would have called AC1 green.
findings.status: FIXED — firstRendered now returns a PATH ending on the node that paints. The drive arm now reads the rect.

findings.what: the outline dragged the box-model inspector chip over the running app
findings.measured: five lines of CSS facts over the hero, in the shot. Every geometry reading was clean.
findings.whyItHid: no number in the drive looked for it. The highlighter takes its inspector focus from the selected and hovered maps, and the outline was being sent down the selection channel — which is what TVW-002 section 2 specified.
findings.status: FIXED — placedNodes is a third map, excluded from focus, on its own guest API and its own IPC channel. It is a graded arm now.

findings.measured: run twice, the second run read five different sentences, one fewer agree row, no outline and 'no Go to door was on screen' — all correct answers about the wrong screen.
findings.whyItHid: the script ENDS by pressing a Go to door, which is its own known-firing control, so it leaves the preview on another page.
findings.status: FIXED — it resets to the start page first and exits 2 if the reset did not take.

findings.what: AC1's first drive read NOTHING because the editor was in Preview mode
findings.measured: the guest reported designMode=false; EditorDocument deliberately pushes no outline in preview mode.
findings.status: instrument fault, not a defect. The drive now reports designMode and says so when it is off.

openForRichard.detachedTheme: the detached preview window never receives data-theme, so it sits on the dark :root defaults whatever the editor is set to. Pre-existing; the strip inherits it. Not fixed here.
